# Browser media fixture

`synthetic-short.mp4` is a 10.9 KiB, one-second, 160×90 H.264 video with no audio or personal content. It contains only a generated teal-to-clay color field and exists under `tests/`, never `public/`.

The fixture was generated locally with Apple's `AVAssetWriter`; it was not downloaded and does not contain family media, a filename, a location, or an account identifier. Its SHA-256 is recorded in the video-feasibility report.
